statements.text: On the glazed tile, the water mainly disappears by evaporating into water vapour.
On the dry sand, seepage into the sand and evaporation can both make the wet patch smaller.
Seepage alone explains both patches, and seepage turns liquid water into water vapour inside the sand.

stem:
Tanya spills the same small amount of water on a glazed bathroom tile and on dry sand in a tray. After some time both wet patches look smaller.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: A glazed tile does not take in water, so disappearance there is evaporation. Dry sand allows both seepage and evaporation. Statement 3 wrongly treats seepage as the only process and as turning liquid into vapour.
